senses.gloss: f. (פָּטַם 1) [pestle, mortar] a protuberance on the blossom-end of fruits having the appearance of a pestle seated in a mortar (cmp. בּוּכְנָה); the upper portion of a fruit, v. פִּיטּוֹמֶת.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:6">Succ. III, 6</cite> <he>נטלה פִטְמָתוֹ</he> if the pestlelike protuberance of an Ethrog is taken out; expl. Y. ib. III, 53ᵈ <he>תמן אמרין שושנתו</he> there (in Babylonia) they say, ‘its lily’; Bab.
<cite ref="Sukkah 35b">ib. 35ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="B00248"><he>בּוּכְנָה</he></cite> (v. Rashi a. l.).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:2:2">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ</cite> top <he>פיטמה של אבטיח</he> (v. <cite ref="M02070"><he>מְעָה</he></cite>) the upper portion of a melon (containing the carpels).
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:3">Ukts. II, 3</cite> <he>הפיטמא של רמון</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>הפטמה</he>) the top-piece of a pomegranate.
